newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka forex market stagnates on low interest.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka forex market stagnates on low interest.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee was untraded against the dollar in early Friday trading after the Central Bank showed it was positive towards the U.S. currency, dealers said.
At 0515 GMT, the rupee was quoted at 59.28 to the greenback, with no trade recorded.
The Central Bank pushed the dollar down only by a quarter local cent despite heavy selling of the currency in international markets, dealers said.
The central bank fixed buying and selling at 58.2194 and 59.3956.
"There are no sellers, as this demonstrates the Central Bank's wish to depreciate the local currency further," a Standard Chartered Bank dealer said.
"If we don't see big buyer either, we are likely to see ranged trading, say between the 59.25-35 range," an American Express Bank dealer said.
Overnight call money rates were at 10 percent after opening at 9.50 percent, dealers said.
